sso.title: Google sign-in
sso.description:
1. Open the [helper page]({helper_url}) and sign in with Google.
2. Copy the SSO token shown there and paste it here.

The group must differ from the group used by Node-RED, otherwise the Node-RED devices are overwritten.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {email} are no longer valid. For Google sign-in get a new token via the [helper page]({helper_url}).

init.title: Exposed entities
init.description: Scenes and scripts become Google scenes ("activate …"), switches and input booleans become switches, lights become lights, climate entities become thermostats.
